scope: Shared D04 footer core verification; native semantic and bounded painter evidence
source_state: main working tree; 21 shared core/profile files identified below
source_hash_algorithm: For each source_files entry in order, SHA256 update(path UTF-8 + NUL + exact file bytes + NUL). Tests and platform UI files excluded.

commands.sanitizer: Exact previously executed command is preserved in asan-ubsan-command.txt; matching CMake flag/link inputs are copied alongside.

audit_findings_fixed.issue: Byte-counted syntax output could overread UTF-8 footer text/highlights and clip or pad wide glyphs incorrectly.
audit_findings_fixed.repair: Band-specific bounded cluster painter uses byte-length decoding, physical profile metrics, byte-indexed colours and logical VERIFY scrolling; existing native cluster writer retains terminal policy.
audit_findings_fixed.proof: Production band painter exercised with exact-length non-NUL Ω/界 arrays, narrow widths, right-edge guard cells, colours, padding and VERIFY before/inside/after a wide glyph; same target passed ASan/UBSan.

audit_findings_fixed.issue: Page stepping subtracted docked footer rows again after geometry had already removed them from FILEAREA.
audit_findings_fixed.repair: find_next_current_line skips footer_after_cmdline nodes in its inline reserved-row subtraction. Other first_reserved loops inspected; none has analogous geometry subtraction.
audit_findings_fixed.proof: 300-line disposable fixture, two docked rows and two inline rows, expected forward/backward page distances, round trips, clean dirty state and byte-identical saved file.

boundary: Focused local core/native proof only. Browser, GTK and console visual gates, hosted CI, installation, publication and release qualification are separate. Original test binaries were not retained or hashed as immutable candidates.
